issues.display_title: Issue #119: PATCH /v1/projects/:id silently downgrades published status
issues.main_description_html:
PATCH /v1/projects/:id (src/action/v1/project/update.go) passes a status field straight through to the DB. The FE editor sends status: "edited" on every save, so a published project is silently downgraded — the dashboard then shows it as "Draft". Publish state has its own endpoints (/publish, /unpublish); the generic PATCH should not be able to leave it.

Fix

  • In Update, ignore the status key when the project's current status is published — publish state only changes via the dedicated publish/unpublish endpoints.

Acceptance criteria

  • PATCH with status: "edited" on a published project leaves status published (other fields still applied).
  • PATCH status changes on non-published projects behave as before.
  • /publish and /unpublish unaffected.
  • Unit test covers the published-downgrade case.

Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer
Parent feedback: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#439

RESULT

Update (src/action/v1/project/update.go) now ignores the status key when the project's current status is published — the generic PATCH can no longer downgrade a published project. Publish state only changes via /publish and /unpublish. Status changes on non-published projects are unchanged, and all other PATCH fields still apply.

Added update_test.go: published project + PATCH {status:"edited", name:...} keeps published while the name updates; draft project still moves to edited.

FE counterpart: gothru-3d-floormap#446 stops sending the downgrade.
